user.title: Sign in to Tuya / Smart Life
user.description: Enter the **user code** from your Smart Life (or Tuya Smart) app. Find it under **Me → ⚙ (Settings) → Account and Security → User Code**. No developer account is needed.

scan.title: Scan to link your account
scan.description: Open the **Smart Life** app, tap **＋ (top right) → Scan**, and scan this QR code. Then press **Submit** below to finish.

select_device.title: Select your fireplace
select_device.description: Choose the fireplace from the devices on your account.

mode.title: Choose how to control the fireplace
mode.description:
Both use the sign-in you just completed.

**Cloud** — commands go via Tuya's cloud; works from anywhere, no local network setup.

**Local** — commands go directly over your LAN using the key just retrieved; faster and keeps working without internet.

local.title: Confirm local connection
local.description: The local key was retrieved automatically. Confirm the fireplace's IP address (auto-detected where possible — otherwise enter it from your router and reserve it) and protocol version.

error.login_error: Login failed. Check the user code, make sure you scanned the QR code with the Smart Life app, and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the fireplace locally. Check the IP address and protocol version, ensure Home Assistant is on the same network, and fully close the Tuya app while testing.

abort.no_devices: No devices were found on this account. Add the fireplace to the Smart Life app first.
abort.no_local_key: The cloud didn't provide a local key for this device, so local mode isn't available. Remove and re-add it using Cloud mode.

error.temp_range: The minimum temperature must be lower than the maximum temperature.

init.title: Scandia fireplace mapping
init.description: Map each fireplace function to its Tuya address — a **function code** (cloud mode, e.g. `switch`) or a **data point number** (local mode, e.g. `1`). Leave an optional field blank to disable that feature. Download the integration's diagnostics to see the addresses your device reports.
